decision: Prefer the Ubuntu 26.04 systemd binary packages and their matching source/package family.
reason: Keep the Ubuntu package relationships, maintainer scripts, service presets and security update path while implementing genuine kernel interfaces.
kernel_strategy: Backport the required upstream interfaces into the BCM kernel with proprietary-module ABI preservation and semantic tests. Do not claim a newer kernel version or fake feature-probe results.
custom_build_trigger: Rebuild only when a demonstrated device integration or build-option change cannot be supplied through units/drop-ins and ordinary configuration.
custom_build_rules: Start with the matching Ubuntu source package and retain its Debian packaging, dependency versions, maintainer scripts and triggers.
Distribute modifications as versioned Debian packages with a recorded source/patch/build manifest; do not copy untracked systemd binaries over dpkg-owned files.
Keep patches small and review upstream/Ubuntu changes when rebasing; a local package needs an explicit update policy.
Do not select a newer upstream release merely to obtain a larger version number; evaluate its additional kernel requirements first.
Keep time64 application defaults enabled and test legacy vendor boundaries individually.
acceptance: Boot PID 1 and execute a real service on the exact candidate kernel; an audit watchdog or an 'about to execute' log is not success.
Verify pidfd lifetime, polling, waiting/reaping, signalling permissions and error cleanup, including ARM32 callers.
Retest apt service-install/restart behavior, udev and the ASUS service ownership/startup changes before a real root switch.
Keep systemd and the package database on the persistent writable Ubuntu root.

demonstrated_custom_build_trigger.failure: Credentials require fsopen/new mount API; original package full base boot fails on kernel10
demonstrated_custom_build_trigger.next_action: Prepare narrowly scoped legacy-mount fallback in matching Ubuntu source packaging, preserving credentials protections; not yet accepted
